# The Project Gallery {#sec-project-gallery .appendix}

## Skeleton

The companion package's project guides mapped by module and
difficulty: personality bots and quiz bots after Part I, document

projects after Part IV, multimodal builds after Part V. Three

demo, portfolio piece).
